name: Image from a Web Address
description: One picture from a web address, fetched each time it is shown: a camera's snapshot, a dashboard or chart image, a weather map. The addresses are kept in the data source's settings, and a task picks one by its name.

properties.name: pictures
properties.title: Pictures
properties.description: The pictures a task can show: a camera's snapshot, a dashboard or chart image, a weather map. A task picks one by its name. Only http and https addresses (PNG, JPEG, GIF or WEBP, up to 10 MB); each is fetched again every time it is shown, so an address that always gives the latest picture always shows the latest. Test fetches the address and says what it found. An address on this device, or in its link-local range, is refused.

properties.name: picture
properties.title: Picture
properties.description: Which picture to show. Add pictures (a name and an address each) in the Image from a Web Address data source settings.

properties.name: shrinkToFit
properties.title: Shrink to Fit
properties.description: Fit the whole picture inside the screen on a blurred margin of its own colors (it is never cropped, and a small picture is not enlarged). Off: the picture is given to the display as it is.
